name: Christian Rasmus Holmes IV
bio: Father of the infamous Elizabeth Holmes. A former corporate executive and government official who worked as a vice president at Enron's Clean Energy Solutions Group and later held leadership roles in federal agencies such as USAID, the EPA, and the USTDA. He is also a descendant of Charles Louis Fleischmann, founder of Fleischmann's Yeast.

credits.title: You Can See Everything
credits.overview: Thirty-four days before she's sent to prison, notorious Silicon Valley founder Elizabeth Holmes invites a skeptical film crew to document her every move. What begins as an intimate portrait of an enigmatic felon becomes a mind-bending three-year journey into the abyss.
